d6fdc69202fef1c0f4e171e9fcae238e25ab4bcf.summary: Symantec's Threat Hunter Team reports that the Budworm APT group used an updated variant of its SysUpdate backdoor in August 2023 against a Middle Eastern telecommunications organization and an Asian government. The attacks used DLL sideloading and living-off-the-land and publicly available tools such as AdFind, SecretsDump and PasswordDumper. The report says only credential harvesting was seen on infected machines. The report describes the group as active since at least 2013 and suggests its motivation is intelligence gathering.

d686d9d7596d3bb1697aee1841d770f90f7df982.summary: FireEye's FLARE team analysed the CARBANAK backdoor's leaked source code (755 files) and operator tools, which they obtained unusually after earlier binary analysis. This first part of a four-part series covers Russian-language source comments, translated C2 and builder interfaces, and anti-analysis features: named-pipe-based command tasking, and obfuscated Windows API import resolution using PJW hashes and C preprocessor macros. The report links the backdoor to financial crimes largely carried out by the group it tracks as FIN7.
